description: Review forgotten downloads and choose what to keep.
heroDescription: Old installers, archives and disk images often linger after you finish with them. Review your Downloads folder and keep the files that still matter.
safety: These are your personal files. Nothing is selected automatically. Only the files you choose will be moved to the Recycle Bin or Trash.
name: Name
startDescription: Start a scan to review files. Your Downloads folder stays untouched until you select files and confirm.
emptyDescription: Try a different age, file type or search. Files inside subfolders aren’t included.
revealError: Couldn’t reveal this file. It may have changed; scan again.
scope: Top-level files only. Folders, files starting with a dot, incomplete downloads, linked files and exclusions are skipped ({{count}} entries). Age means last modified, not last opened. Old doesn’t always mean unwanted.
limited: This is a partial review: the scan reached its time or file limit. Only the listed files can be selected.
selectionHint: Review each selection before moving it.
confirmDescription: Check that you no longer need these downloads. Restoring them from Bin / Trash returns them to a Kudu recovery folder inside Downloads; move them back to Downloads afterwards. Changed or excluded files will be skipped.
skipped_one: {{count}} file couldn’t be moved or changed since the scan. Scan again to review it.
skipped_other: {{count}} files couldn’t be moved or changed since the scan. Scan again to review them.
binSpace: Disk space is released when the Recycle Bin or Trash is emptied.
skipped_zero: {{count}} files couldn’t be moved or changed since the scan. Scan again to review them.
skipped_two: {{count}} files couldn’t be moved or changed since the scan. Scan again to review them.
skipped_few: {{count}} files couldn’t be moved or changed since the scan. Scan again to review them.
skipped_many: {{count}} files couldn’t be moved or changed since the scan. Scan again to review them.
recoveryTitle: Some files were preserved for recovery
recoveryDescription: Kudu could not safely put these files back in Downloads. They remain at the paths below; move them back manually when the destination is free.
restoreHint: Restoring from Bin / Trash returns files to a Kudu recovery folder inside Downloads. Move them back to Downloads afterwards.
